comment: Explicit EMC base values for ingots/materials that ProjectE + ProjectE Integration do NOT resolve automatically (verified by decompiling ProjectE-1.21.1-PE1.1.0.jar and ProjectE_Integration-8.3.1.jar — see scratchpad/projecte/design.md and the economy README for the derivation of every number). Carried over from the P2-gating draft: tfmg:steel_ingot and northstar:martian_steel_ingot. titanium is RE-OVERRIDDEN here from the earlier draft's 8192 to 10240 per the updated pricing target (probe = 1000x unit EMC, ~10M for the planetary tier). tungsten is overridden from PEI's own default of 356 (too cheap for a P6-only resource) to the same 10240 planetary tier. Everything below uses an id-based 'before' entry so it wins over any tag-based default from ProjectE/PEI (id > tag priority is ProjectE's documented convention, but has NOT been confirmed by an actual server log in this pack — check the ProjectE EMC-remap log on first boot).
